name: CM49_engine_math_is_distilled
origins: user requirement 2026-10-22 (distill my Unreal Engine's math into the model, by use, with its Gödel logic carrying)
statement: A game engine's math is read through the real compiler (its typed AST, templates instantiated, its scalar path) and becomes cards: every function of the math universe is lifted to terms over the ledger's atoms or carries the cause that stops it; each lifted function has a definition whose canonical form over the reals, semantic hash, Gödel content, number and structural tokens are computed, and whose action is the engine's own compiled code, linked by a witness on seeded inputs that a planted wrong term fails; equal canonical forms are identities, and every function is an atom of the engine's Gödel set, carried to its definition's content.
